content:
kevin: Postmortem follow-up: we need three actionable updates to the runbook/playbook so we can close remediation actions. Dropping owners here.

jin: I'll own the triage checklist + minimal incident_collect.sh. Plan: 5 quick commands and upload to incidents bucket. PR by Mon EOD.

sara: I'll own the "when to page" section and add a TL;DR block at the top. Proposed thresholds: sustained p95 >10% for 8m OR error_rate >0.75% for 4m.

misha: I'll update escalation matrix with PD service names and add the 30-min exec notify step, plus explicit fallback routing API calls. PR by Thu.

kevin: Good. Quick example commands to include in triage checklist (jin please paste exact snippets in PR):
```bash
# metrics snapshot
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 50
# model cache summary
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary
# last 300 runtime logs
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 300 --no-pager | tail -n 300
```

jin: Will add those and annotate which fields to check (queue_depth, kv_hit_rate, model_load_time_ms). incident_collect.sh will run them and s3cli upload.

sara: I'll also add a 1-line decision box: "If deploy timestamp within 10m of spike -> check cache prewarm and consider rollback".

misha: Escalation snippet I'll add: PUT /admin/routing {"variant":"fallback"}; POST /admin/cache/prewarm; systemctl restart redwood-worker@<id>. Will map exact PD services.

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-5012: "runbook/playbook edits - triage, paging, escalation". Assigned to jin, sara, misha. Due 2026-04-12.

kevin: Final owners/dates: jin - triage checklist + incident_collect.sh (PR Mon 2026-04-06); sara - when-to-page + TL;DR (PR Wed 2026-04-08); misha - PD mapping + escalation edits (PR Thu 2026-04-09). Sync Fri 09:15 to review. Add blockers here. :thumbsup:
